name: Plain away entry stores standing text byte for byte, identifies its source, and preserves the authority boundary
Wordless refresh keeps the current mandate after the standing file changes, disappears, or becomes a FIFO
Typed replacement archives the original mandate and the return report attributes its standing-file source
Absent, empty, directory, dangling, unreadable, and FIFO standing paths allow away entry with the specified warning
Explicit words and words files, including empty inputs, bypass the standing file
Quiet entry and refresh never open the standing file; conversion to away uses it
